comment: Phase 1 gate policy. A video FAILS on any objective blocking/major failure, any dimension below min_any_dimension, or any dimension below its threshold. Phase 2: hook candidates and script variants are scored by the same reviewer (review-hooks / review-script) against hook_thresholds / script_thresholds. Phase 3.5: CTA dims (cta_thresholds) apply only when a CTA is present, in video and script reviews; CTA placement gates are objective (CTA.*). Phase 4: package candidates (title + thumbnail + opening promise + copy) are gated deterministically by package_engine.py against `packaging` and scored by review-package against package_thresholds; an unsupported or contradicted claim is blocking.
